title: [Bug] Claude Code reasoning quality degradation in versions 2.1.8+
body:
**Bug Description**
claude seems to have become "dumber" in it's choices lately.  maybe past week or so?  this is down from two weeks ago where it seemed like claude had a major uptick in smartness (corresponding to making ultrathink the default).  seems 2.1.7 was really good and 2.1.13 and later is not that great.  I feel like it keeps missing things and I have to guide it more.  around 2.1.7 it was getting to be like, "this is really cool, it's guessing everything right 95% of the time".  Now it's even below the 85% that I've gotten used to.  Maybe I would say it's down to 75% accuracy... :(

Anyone else feel this recently?

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: windows-terminal
- Version: 2.1.22
- Feedback ID: ab099d5b-d766-4c76-94d8-b3c2794028e1
author: Caleb-KS
